notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least four cards in their hand.
description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}, targeting an opponent with at least four cards in their hand.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Jeska's Will.
Resolve the copy of Jeska's Will, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
